title: Hamburger menu: full-viewport panel with section subtitles
description: Ryan, 2026-09-26: the pop-up hamburger menu clusters items too tightly. Replace the small popup with a full-viewport panel: each section title in the display face with a one-line subtitle explaining it, generous spacing, dividers. Subtitles live in the menu link config and are hidden in the desktop bar.
